css: *{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:transparent;color:#20222b;font:13px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}button,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #426cff;outline-offset:2px}#tool-status{display:none}.toc-panel{padding:12px;border:1px solid #e9e9ef;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;min-width:0}.toc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}.toc-title{font-size:12px;color:#727685;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.045em}.toc-modes{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1px;padding:2px;border:1px solid #e9e9ef;border-radius:8px;background:#fafafd}.toc-modes button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:27px;height:27px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:#858996}.toc-modes button svg{width:14px;height:14px}.toc-modes button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:#303342;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #171d2a15}.toc-source{width:100%;margin:0 0 7px;padding:5px;border:1px solid #e9e9ef;border-radius:6px;color:inherit;background:transparent;font-size:12px}.toc-scroll{max-height:540px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;overscroll-behavior:contain}.toc-list{display:grid;gap:1px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.toc-list li{padding-left:calc(var(--depth,0)*12px);min-width:0}.toc-link{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-left:2px solid transparent;padding:2px 0 2px 10px;background:transparent;color:#6b7280;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}.toc-link.child{font-size:12px}.toc-link:hover,.toc-link[aria-current=location]{color:#20222b}.toc-link[aria-current=location]{border-left-color:#426cff}.toc-link span{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-height:2.9em}.toc-empty,.toc-error{font-size:12px;margin:7px 0 0;color:#777b8a}.toc-error{color:#b04c59}.toc-more{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:6px;padding:7px 8px;text-align:left;border:1px solid #e9e9ef;border-radius:7px;background:#f8f9fc;color:#5062a0;font-size:12px}.toc-more:hover{background:#eef2ff;color:#2c49b6}.toc-more[hidden]{display:none}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){body{color:#e6e8ef}.toc-panel{background:#1b1c24;border-color:#383a48}.toc-title{color:#a4a7b3}.toc-modes{background:#16171e;border-color:#383a48}.toc-modes button{color:#8b90a1}.toc-modes button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#2a2d3a;color:#e3e7f4}.toc-source{border-color:#383a48}.toc-link{color:#a0a5b4}.toc-link:hover,.toc-link[aria-current=location]{color:#f4f5f7}.toc-more{background:#272936;color:#acbfff;border-color:#383a48}.toc-more:hover{background:#303850;color:#d4dfff}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
